main.description: Canonical evolution event record written by EvolutionEmissionCell on simeon. Persisted to MST + IPFS pin + Base L2 anchor per ADR-2605215200 §1.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent whose karma level advanced.

previousLevel.description: Karma level before this evolution event.

newLevel.description: Karma level after this evolution event.

claimId.description: UUID of the validated evolution claim from EvolutionValidationCell.

validatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evolution claim was validated.

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of evidence records supporting the evolution claim.

attestationDids.description: DIDs of Council members who attested to this evolution claim.

l2AnchorTxHash.description: Base L2 transaction hash from the ADR-2605171800 Stage 5 anchor pipeline.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes from the attesting Council member.

effectiveMultiplier.description: Phenotype effectiveMultiplier delta in permille (0–1000) per ADR-2605192230.
